claims.content: Allow the Customer to browse and search for products on the site.

goal.raw_text: Allow the Customer to browse and search for products on the site.

claims.content: Customer
The system must have a global site header and footer available.
Products intended for display on search results or catalog pages must have an available image to display; otherwise, they are not eligible to appear.
The Customer initiates the use case by navigating to the site's catalog or search interface, typically by clicking on a product category or entering search criteria.

trigger.raw_text: The Customer initiates the use case by navigating to the site's catalog or search interface, typically by clicking on a product category or entering search criteria.

claims.content: The Customer navigates from the Home Page to the Catalog Pages.

The system displays the Category 'Browse' or Search Result Pages, which include a global site header & footer, a navigational bread crumb trail, and an Endeca navigation section on the left side for drill-down capabilities.

The system displays Product Modules for eligible items (items with available images), each containing a thumbnail image, short description ('On-Air Description'), countdown timer, current high bid, and a 'QuickBid' button.
The Customer views the product details by clicking anywhere within the product module (except the QuickBid button).
If the user is not signed in, the system presents a sign-in page; upon completion, the user is delivered to the Product Details (bidding) page.
If the Customer clicks the 'QuickBid' button while not signed in, the system prompts them to sign in; upon completion, the user is returned to the catalog page rather than the product details page.
Closed items are automatically removed from the search results or catalog pages within 1 minute (or a configured interval) after closing.

Before allowing a bid (via QuickBid or SmartBid), if the bidder has not signed in, the system redirects them to the sign-in page; after signing in, they are returned to the product details page to complete the action.
When a customer places a bid, a 'Bid Confirmation Pop-up' appears requiring confirmation (Yes/Cancel); during this pop-up, the rest of the page is grayed out and unclickable.

If a search results in no matches, the system displays a 'No Results Found' page. This page includes a 'Popular Searches' links section (with static lists for gemstones and jewelry), a list of dynamically updated search terms, and 'Search Tips' to help the customer refine their query.
Closed items are automatically removed from the search results or catalog pages within 1 minute (or a configured interval) after closing.
Only products with an available image are eligible to appear on the search results or catalog pages.
